units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:1:24">Y. Sabb. I, 2ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>לא לח וכ׳</he> neither wet, nor dry, but between the two (moist). <he>אדם ב׳</he> a man of average strength.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:22">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> bot.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sotah 42b:5">Sot. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ שבאחיו</he> the middle betw. his brothers (the third of five).—Pl. <cite ref="B00643"><he>בֵּינוֹנִים</he></cite>, <he>בֵּינוֹנִיִּים</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:7">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>בֵּינוֹנֵי המדינה</he> people of the middle class, opp. <he>גדולי</he>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:7:1">Koh. R. to IX, 7</cite> <he>הבינונים</he>; Tanḥ. Emor 22 <he>בריוני</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16b:12">R. Hash. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳</he> those between the very good and the very bad; a. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="B00643"><he>בֵּינוֹנִית</he></cite>.
Gitt. V, 1, a. fr. (sub. שדה) a field of average fertility; betw. עידית a. זיבורית.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:1:14">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הב׳</he> the intermediate rainy season.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:2:14">Y. Ber. V, 9ᶜ</cite> bot. there are three things of which too much or too little is obnoxious <he>ובֵינוֹנִיתָן יפה</he> but a reasonable quantity good.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:10">Ib. 10</cite> <he>היו ב׳</he> were mean cubits; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:1:9">Y. Shek. VI, 49ᵈ</cite> top <he>הוא כבניינות</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 8:3:8">Y. Sot. VIII, 22ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>בבינויות</he> (corr. acc.).
